questions.title: Let the assistant run commands on this machine?
questions.help: If you turn this on, the assistant can run any command as a user that is equivalent to root on this box. A web page or a stored memory could talk it into running something harmful. There is no sandboxed option. Leave it off unless you want that. Running these screens again turns it off unless you turn it on here again; you can also turn it on later with: hal0 agent install hermes --terminal-tool

questions.title: Which model should memory use?
questions.help: Shared uses the chat model. Memory needs a chat model to work.
